title: Synthesis of N-formamides via oxidative carbonylation of amines with paraformaldehyde over a CoNC catalyst
content:
RSC Sustain., 2025, 3,395-402
DOI: 10.1039/D4SU00591K, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Longfei Wang, Yuanyuan Hu, Qingqing Pu, Yongqiang Yao, Hao Zhang, Yong Guo, Yongsheng Li, Bin Dai, Zhengang Ke
A green route for the synthesis of N-formamides was reported via the oxidative carbonylation of amines with paraformaldehyde over a non-noble metal CoNC-700 catalyst. This reaction is generally realized using noble metal Au, Ir and Ag catalysts.
